subject: LLM SDK mapping & harmonization sprint — LangChain + LlamaIndex
messages:
From: Ben Cho <ben@promptcraft.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: asha@promptcraft.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — LangChain/LlamaIndex harmonization idea

Hi Dylan — great to connect at the summit. PromptCraft has been building a compatibility shim for LangChain and LlamaIndex extensions to make tracing and prompt metadata portable across runtimes. We think a short co-engagement sprint with Redwood could help customers adopt both SDKs with Redwood runtime hooks (token-level attribution, KV cache hints).

High-level ask: 2-week technical sprint to exercise the shim on a small reference app, deliver a short SOW and integration checklist, and publish a joint how‑to.

Attached: PromptCraft_SOW_v1.pdf (draft) and a proposed checklist.

Proposed next step: calendar for a 30‑minute scoping call next week.

Thanks,
Ben Cho
Head of Partnerships | PromptCraft.ai

PromptCraft_SOW_v1.pdf (attachment)
sdk-mapping-checklist.csv (attachment)

From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LL M SDK mapping & harmonization sprint — LangChain + LlamaIndex

Ben — thanks for the note and the SOW draft. This aligns closely with work our SDK/interop team has been asking for. Quick answers up front:
- We can commit a small cross-functional sprint (engineering + DX writer + integrations PM).
- Key acceptance criteria: (1) demo app that exercises streaming + function calls, (2) trace export to our tracing endpoint, (3) a short integration guide plus a reference repo.

Looping Soojin (runtime integrations) and Vanessa (ISV program) to scope resources and timelines. Soojin — can your team take the technical lead on the sprint? Vanessa — if we proceed, we'll want a 60/40 content co-marketing schedule in the SOW and clarity on account-level support for pilot customers.

I can be the primary Redwood contact. Suggest a scoping call Mon 10/4 or Tue 10/5.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference

Note: please review the SOW attachments; I'll share comments inline during the call.

Dylan/Vanessa — happy to lead the technical side. Quick technical notes after a 15‑minute look at the SOW: 
- We need to add a security/compliance clause: access to trace export must be scoped and ephemeral for pilot customers (redact PII by default).
- Acceptance tests should include: (a) end-to-end trace containing token attribution, (b) KV cache warmup demo showing latency improvement, (c) sample prompt fewshot that rounds-trip through both SDKs and yields consistent outputs.
- Estimate: 2 engineers (1 runtime, 1 integrations) for 2 weeks; 0.4 FTE docs. Rough cost impact: we'll draft a staffed SOW to match PromptCraft's draft.

Marissa — can you prep a short template we can reuse for ISV co-engagement SOWs (billing milestone + co-marketing)?

— Soojin
